How to use 3S Admin for The Konark Academy

3S Admin lets the school update thekonarkacademy.com without a developer: staff, photos, news, notices, fees, CBSE documents and more. This guide walks through every screen with pictures.

Admin address3sgroupadmin.com
Loginthe admin email shared with you
Website it updatesthekonarkacademy.com
Changes go liveAbout 10 seconds after Publish

How a change reaches the website

Every update follows the same four steps.

1. Sign in

Password plus the 6-digit code from your phone.

2. Edit and Save

Open a section, change it, press Save.

3. Publish

Dashboard → Publish to website.

4. Live

Refresh thekonarkacademy.com after about 10 seconds.

Getting started

Signing in

Open 3sgroupadmin.com in any browser - computer or phone. There is one login for the admin.

The first sign-in: set up the authenticator app

The admin asks for a second, 6-digit code every time you sign in. It comes from a free app on your phone, so nobody can get in with the password alone.

1Install the app

Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, from the Play Store or App Store.

2Scan the QR code

After your password, the admin shows a QR code once. In the app tap + and scan it.

3Type the code

The app now shows a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Type it in to finish.

4Every time after

Email, password, then the current code from the app. That's it.

Sharing the login

If two people will use the admin, scan the same QR code on both phones during that first setup - the QR code is shown only once.

You are signed out automatically

Closing the browser signs you out, and so do 2 hours without any activity. This keeps the admin safe on shared or office computers. Just sign in again.

Getting started

Choosing the website

After signing in you see every 3S Group website. Today The Konark Academy is connected; the others will appear here as they join.

Getting started

The dashboard and the Publish button

The dashboard is the home of each website: everything you can edit, new enquiries, and recent changes.

Save, then Publish

Save keeps your change in the admin. Publish to website puts all saved changes on thekonarkacademy.com. You can save many changes and publish once at the end.

Getting started

Finding your way around

The menu on the left lists every part of the website. On a phone, open it with the menu button at the top.

Everyday tasks

Staff Directory

Teachers, office staff and leadership shown on the website. Teaching staff appear on the Teaching Staff page, grouped by wing.

Add a new teacher

  1. Open Staff Directory and click Add.
  2. Type the Full name (e.g. Ms. Priya Sharma) and Designation (e.g. PRT Teacher).
  3. Set Directory to Teaching Staff and pick the Wing / Department.
  4. Click Upload a photo and choose the photo from your computer or phone.
  5. Click Save, then Publish to website on the dashboard.
Photos

Use a clear, upright portrait with the face near the top. Photos from a phone are fine.

Everyday tasks

Teaching Wings

The sections of the Teaching Staff page: Primary Wing, Middle Wing, Senior Wing, Sports Wing and so on.

A wing with teachers cannot be deleted

Move its teachers to another wing first (in Staff Directory), then hide or delete the wing. This way no teacher disappears from the website by accident.

Order

The order of wings in this list is the order on the website. Use the up/down arrows to change it.

Everyday tasks

Photo Gallery, News, Achievements and Videos

These sections all work the same way: a list you can search, filter, reorder, hide and add to.

SectionWhat you addWhere it shows on the website
Photo GalleryTitle, photo, category. Type a new category to create it.Gallery page, with category filters
News & EventsHeadline, month (e.g. August 2026), newspaper clipping imageNews & Events page, grouped by month

Everyday tasks

The homepage: announcement and highlights

Two small sections control what visitors see first on the homepage.

Everyday tasks

Event Greetings (pop-ups)

A pop-up on the website for a festival, a national day, an exam notice or admissions. Each one shows only between the start and end dates you choose.

  1. Open Event Greetings and click Add.
  2. Pick an occasion (Diwali, Independence Day, Sports Day...) or Start from a blank form.
  3. Check the wording, choose a banner, and set Show from and Show until.
  4. Use Preview to see the pop-up as visitors will, then Save and Publish.
It switches itself off

After the end date the pop-up stops showing by itself. You don't need to delete it.

Everyday tasks

Contact details and office hours

Phone numbers, WhatsApp, emails, address and office timings used across the whole website.

Check before saving

A wrong number here changes it everywhere on the website. Type numbers exactly as they should be dialled.

Everyday tasks

CBSE Mandatory Disclosure

The disclosure page CBSE requires. Its rows are fixed by CBSE: you update the values and upload documents, but don't add or remove rows.

Staff numbers update themselves

The teacher counts on the disclosure page are worked out from the Staff Directory, so keep the directory up to date and the counts follow.

Enquiries and reports

Feedback & Leads

Everything parents and visitors send from the website: admission enquiries and parent feedback. Enquiries are also emailed to the school as before.

Enquiries and reports

Analytics

How many people visit the website, which pages they read, where they come from and what they do - straight from Google Analytics.

On the pageWhat it tells you
Traffic over timePage views, visitors or visits per day (hour by hour for Today and Yesterday). Hover for exact numbers.
Admission interest journeyFrom visits to enquiries: how many visitors started a form, reached out on WhatsApp or phone, and sent an enquiry.
How they found the websiteGoogle search, typed the address, social media, links on other websites...
Most viewed pages, Devices, Where visitors areThe popular pages, mobile vs computer, and the visitors' city, state or country.
What visitors didWhatsApp chats, phone taps, forms started, enquiries sent, parent login clicks.
Why today looks low

Google can take a few hours to count the latest visits, so today's numbers keep rising through the day.

Enquiries and reports

Activity log

A record of every change made in the admin - what was changed, in which section, and when. It cannot be edited, so it is a reliable history.

Help

Hide or delete?

Most items can be hidden or deleted. When in doubt, hide.

Hide (eye icon)
  • Disappears from the website after Publish.
  • Stays in the admin, greyed out.
  • Bring it back any time with one click.
Delete permanently (bin icon)
  • Removed from the admin and the website.
  • Cannot be undone.
  • Use for mistakes and old items nobody needs.

Help

Common questions

I saved a change but the website still shows the old one.

Press Publish to website on the dashboard, wait about 10 seconds and refresh the website. Saving alone does not change the live website.

I forgot the password.

On the sign-in screen click Forgot password?. A code is emailed to the admin email. Enter it and choose a new password.

The phone with the authenticator app was lost or changed.

Contact the 3S Group web team. They can reset the authenticator so you can scan a new QR code.

A photo will not upload.

Photos must be JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF and under 10 MB. Large phone photos can be sent to yourself on WhatsApp first, which makes them smaller.

I cannot delete a wing.

A wing that still has teachers cannot be hidden or deleted. Move its teachers to another wing in Staff Directory first.

I deleted something by mistake.

If you chose Just hide it, open the item and tick Published again. A permanent delete cannot be undone - add the item again.

I was signed out.

This happens when the browser is closed or after 2 hours without activity. Sign in again; your saved work is safe.
